name: Volcanic & aviation ash
value: No red aviation codes on major routes
summary: No red aviation codes on major routes; Mayon at alert level 3
state: No volcano was at aviation colour code red near major air routes as of 3 Nov, and no large explosive eruption was reported. Mayon in the Philippines remains at alert level 3 with ash emissions (GMA), and Kīlauea continues episodic fountaining, neither affecting international routes.
for_you: No action needed; airlines publish disruption notices if ash affects routes.
rubric_hit: No orange/red code near major routes

sources.title: USGS — Volcano Observatory Notices for Aviation

why: Major eruptions ground flights (Iceland 2010) and can cool the climate for years.
drivers: Volcanic unrest; impact depends on ash plume height and jet-stream direction.

rubric.alert: Major airspace closures from ash, or a VEI 4+ eruption.
rubric.watch: Aviation colour code orange/red at a volcano near major air routes, or a large eruption.
rubric.normal: No aviation colour code red; no large eruptions.
